_readme: Government programme -> the listed companies that were actually seen winning work under it, from three years of NSE order filings (2023-09 to 2026-09). "n" is how many such filings that company made: it is evidence of participation, not a recommendation, and a company can appear under several programmes. "history" states what the basket did base-to-peak from the policy date against the whole market over the same window (runbook 144c). The routine must still verify, from the company own filings, that the programme is material to it.

defence.name: Defence procurement and indigenisation
defence.keywords: ministry of defence|defence|army|navy|air force|drdo|indigenisation|hal\b|bdl|bel\b|defence acquisition council|(?<!-)dac\b|emergency procurement
defence.history: First positive indigenisation list 9-Aug-2020. The 34 companies that later won defence orders ran a median 17.4x base-to-peak against 4.3x for the market over the same window; 76% of them made 5x.

R P P Infra Projects Ltd

shipbuilding.name: Shipbuilding, shipyards and ports
shipbuilding.history: Same 2020 indigenisation push: 21 companies, median 16.2x, 81% made 5x.

R P P Infra Projects Ltd

railways.name: Railways capex, Vande Bharat, Kavach
railways.keywords: railway|rail\b|vande bharat|kavach|metro rail|dedicated freight|rvnl|ircon|rites|konkan|high speed rail
railways.history: FY23 Budget 1-Feb-2022 put Rs 2.45 lakh cr into railways and promised 400 Vande Bharat trains: 68 companies, median 4.4x vs 3.0x for the market, 44% made 5x.

companies.name: R P P Infra Projects Ltd

smart_meters.name: Smart meters and power distribution (RDSS)
smart_meters.keywords: rdss|smart meter|prepaid meter|distribution sector scheme|discom|aggregate technical|at&c loss|advanced metering
smart_meters.history: Cabinet approved the Rs 3.04 lakh cr RDSS on 30-Jun-2021: the 8 companies that won that work ran a median 12.0x vs 3.2x for the market, and every one of them made 5x.

companies.name: GMR Power and Urban Infra Ltd

transmission.name: Power transmission and grid
transmission.history: The FY23 capex cycle: 47 companies, median 4.7x vs 3.0x, 49% made 5x.

solar_kusum.name: Solar: KUSUM, SECI tenders, rooftop
solar_kusum.history: PM-KUSUM scale-up Nov-2020: 26 companies, median 5.5x vs 4.1x. But PM Surya Ghar (13-Feb-2024) UNDERPERFORMED the market (1.8x vs 2.0x) - a household subsidy is not an order book.

water_jjm.name: Water: Jal Jeevan, AMRUT, sewerage
water_jjm.keywords: jal jeevan|har ghar jal|amrut|drinking water|water supply|sewerage|namami gange|river interlink
water_jjm.history: Rs 50,000 cr in the FY22 Budget (1-Feb-2021): 8 companies, median 6.7x vs 3.7x.

companies.name: Denta Water and Infra Solutions Ltd

roads.name: Roads and highways
roads.history: FY22 Budget road outlay: 31 companies, median 4.1x vs 3.7x - barely beat the market. Roads are the most crowded, most competitively bid theme.

telecom_bharatnet.name: BharatNet, BSNL and telecom
telecom_bharatnet.history: Amended BharatNet, Rs 1.39 lakh cr, 4-Aug-2023: 18 companies, median 2.5x vs 2.3x. Only Sterlite (17.1x) and Tera Software (14.3x) really ran.

ethanol_cbg.name: Ethanol, biofuel and compressed bio-gas
ethanol_cbg.history: Too few order filings to measure a basket; kept for coverage.

companies.name: Swan Defence And Heavy Industries Ltd

semiconductor_esdm.name: Semiconductors and electronics manufacturing
semiconductor_esdm.keywords: semiconductor|display fab|\bosat\b|\bospd\b|chip|fab unit|electronics manufacturing|\bism\b|compound semiconductor|pcb|printed circuit
semiconductor_esdm.history: India Semiconductor Mission approved 15-Dec-2021 (Rs 76,000 cr). NOT measurable from order filings: these companies do not file order wins, so this basket is empty on purpose and the run must build it from the universe and record what it finds here.

bess.name: Battery energy storage (BESS)
bess.history: No measured basket history yet; BESS order filings only began in volume in 2025.

companies.name: Pace Digitek Ltd
companies.why: Own Reg-30 order filings: 23-Oct-2025 SECI 600MW/1200MWh BESS supply Rs1,159.31 cr incl GST; 26-Nov-2025 L&T PO for LFP BESS containers (Bihar) Rs199.42 cr incl taxes (subsidiary Lineage Power); 03-Dec-2025 Advait Greenergy LFP BESS Rs99.71 cr; 10-Feb-2026 KREDL 250MW solar + 250MW/1100MWh BESS ~Rs1,775 cr incl GST; 18-Feb-2026 Yaqin Chem mobile BESS USD 1.35 mn; 30-Mar-2026 NTPC Nabinagar BESS EPC Rs494.54 cr excl GST; 07-May-2026 DVC Maithon 250MW/500MWh Rs701.95 cr incl GST; 16-May-2026 NLC India Renewables 250MW/500MWh Rs709.92 cr incl GST; 21-Aug-2026 Kalpa Power 100MWh Rs92.93 cr; 21-Sep-2026 NTPC GE Power Services BESS containers Rs488.46 cr. Sum of BESS-only orders (ex-KREDL hybrid, ex-USD PO) ~Rs3,946 cr.

companies.name: Oriana Power Limited
companies.why: NSE SME filings: 07-Jul-2025 LoA NVVN 125MW/250MWh standalone BESS Rajasthan (BOO, VGF Rs67.5 cr) Rs465.15 cr over term; 09-Jul-2025 BESPA executed 50MW/100MWh Rajasthan; 14-Jul-2025 LoA KPTCL 50MW/100MWh Karnataka Rs212.32 cr; 18-Aug-2025 agreement 75MW solar + ~111.57MWh BESS Rajasthan Rs476.13 cr incl GST; 24-Mar-2026 three C&I solar+BESS (20MWh) EPC orders Rs162.68 cr excl GST; 21-Sep-2026 two MSEDCL LoAs 900MW/1800MWh BESS (Rs2.40/2.38 lakh/MW/month), ~Rs3,870 cr over 15-yr BESPA, VGF Rs324 cr. 01-Apr-2026 release: 800+ MWh secured BESS.

companies.name: Solarworld Energy Solutions Ltd
companies.why: 08-Dec-2025 signed BESPA with GUVNL for 200MW/400MWh BESS (developer), ~Rs806.40 cr over 12 years excl taxes; 29/30-Mar-2026 three NTPC BESS EPC LoAs: Solapur Lot-1 132MW/264MWh Rs314.26 cr, Unchahar 50MW/100MWh Rs108.22 cr, Solapur Lot-2 75MW/150MWh Rs176.91 cr (all excl taxes). Press releases (17-Oct-2025) state a 3.4 GW BESS line under development.

companies.name: Bondada Engineering Ltd
companies.why: BSE filings: 27-May-2025 TGGENCO LoA 50MW/100MWh BESS (BOO, VGF) Rs204.20 cr incl GST over 12 yrs (its first BESS order); 24-Jun-2025 TNGECL LoA 200MW/400MWh BESS (BOO) Rs836.01 cr incl GST over 12 yrs; 05-Jan-2026 APTRANSCO LoA 225MW/450MWh standalone BESS (BOO) Rs627.00 cr - filing says cumulative BESS portfolio ~1 GWh; 20-Jul-2026 NTPC REL notification of award, EPC for 100MWh vanadium redox flow BESS at Khavda (value not stated).

companies.name: GP Eco Solutions India Limited
companies.why: NSE SME: 30-Sep-2024 orders for 1.3MW BESS from HPSEBL Rs10.50 cr; 24-Sep-2025 LoI from Oriana Power for 2 x 2.5MW/5MWh container BESS (iNVERGY make); 14-Jul-2026 orders incl. Invergy BESS 20MWh Rs19.00 cr (part of Rs72.06 cr). 07-Nov-2025 release: 3 GW BESS facility to commence Jan-2026. Small orders relative to grid-scale peers.

companies.name: H.G. Infra Engineering Ltd
companies.why: BESS developer (BOO): 22-Nov-2024 LoA NVVN 185MW/370MWh at Rs2.38 lakh/MW/month; 04-Jan-2025 LoI GUVNL Phase-IV 250MW/500MWh; 28-May-2025 LoI GUVNL Phase-VI 300MW/600MWh. BESPAs executed 23-Dec-2024 and 28-Nov-2025 (SPVs H.G. Banaskantha / Choraniya BESS). Values not stated beyond tariff.

companies.name: Enviro Infra Engineers Ltd
companies.why: 28-Mar-2026 and 30-Mar-2026 NTPC LoAs for BESS projects in two states each: Rs664.33 cr and Rs405.71 cr (excl GST), incl ~11 yrs CAMC. Press release 02-Apr-2026 calls it entry into BESS.

companies.name: Waaree Renewable Technologies Ltd
companies.why: 18-May-2026 order intimation 350MW/1400MWh BESS (value not stated in the filing text read); 28-Aug-2026 LoA for EPC 291MWp solar + 280MWh BESS (value not in text read). Q1FY27 release (22-Jul-2026): order book Rs5,300+ cr; BESS bid pipeline 10 GWh+.

companies.name: VIVIANA
companies.why: 24-Oct-2025: LoI from RVUNL for share of 1000MW/2000MWh standalone BESS (BOO, VGF) Rs302.46 cr over 12 yrs; 02-Jan-2026: GUVNL award 65MW/130MWh BESS (BOO) Rs208.74 cr over 12 yrs incl taxes. 12-Feb-2026 release: BESS order book Rs509 cr vs Power T&D Rs765 cr.

companies.name: Prostarm Info Systems Ltd
companies.why: 16-Jun-2025 LoI BSPGCL 30MW/120MWh BESS (BOO, Rs15.98 cr/yr rental, 12 yrs); 05-Sep-2025 LoA KPTCL 150MW/300MWh BESS at Doni (Rs45.72 cr/yr rental, 12 yrs, VGF). (20-Aug-2025 L1 filing for the same KPTCL project not counted.)

companies.name: HECPROJECT
companies.why: 21-Aug-2025 Rs7.15 cr BESS 185MW + 220kV substation work from Advait Energy Transitions; 14-Jan-2026 Rs16.35 cr BOS for 60MW/115.37MWh BESS from Advait Greenergy.

companies.name: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Ltd
companies.why: Press releases: 26-Jul-2024 LoIs incl. EPC of a GWh-scale BESS (~Rs328 cr for two projects incl. a floating solar); 15-Jan-2026 a pure BESS order from an Indian IPP; 22-Sep-2026 South Africa order incl. 2 x 308MWh BESS (total with a Rajasthan solar order ~Rs985 cr). BESS values not separated.

companies.name: SPML Infra Ltd
companies.why: 06-May-2026: Rs1,128 cr contract from NTPC for 1 GWh BESS at Barauni TPS. 04-Sep-2026: own 104.4 kWh battery pack; 13-Aug-2026 says BESS manufacturing progressing towards revenue.

companies.name: Power Mech Projects Ltd
companies.why: 08-Jan-2026: WBSEDCL award 250MW/1000MWh standalone BESS at Goaltore, Rs3,126 cr excl GST incl greenshoe, O&M 180 months.

companies.name: GK Energy Ltd
companies.why: 21-Sep-2026: MSEDCL LoA 150MW/300MWh BESS, tariff Rs2.38 lakh/MW/month = Rs42.84 cr/yr for 15 yrs.

companies.name: Advait Energy Transitions Ltd
companies.why: 31-Mar-2026: 150MW/300MWh standalone BESS in Gujarat at Rs2.10 lakh/MW/month (BOO). HEC Infra filings show Advait awarding BESS BOS work (185MW, 60MW/115MWh).

companies.name: KPI Green Energy Ltd
companies.why: 03-Jan-2026: LoI from GUVNL for 445MW/890MWh IPP standalone BESS at multiple locations (value not stated).

companies.name: G R Infraprojects Ltd
companies.why: 29-Mar-2026: NTPC notification of award, EPC package for BESS at NTPC thermal stations (Lot-1), Rs413.37 cr excl GST.

companies.name: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Ltd
companies.why: 27-Mar-2026: material step-down subsidiary order for supply and integration of BESS (international), ~Rs152 cr, option up to Rs292 cr.

companies.name: Rajesh Power Services Ltd
companies.why: 05-Jan-2026 BSE filing: LoI from GUVNL for 65MW/130MWh standalone BESS at Virpore (TBCB Phase-VII, VGF via PSDF); value not stated in the filing.

companies.name: Ceigall India Ltd
companies.why: 09-Feb-2026 LoA (Rewa Ultra Mega Solar) for Morena solar + BESS project, tariff Rs2.70/kWh, ~Rs1,700 cr project value incl GST (developer, 25-yr PPA executed 30-Jun-2026). 13-May-2026 L1 for 100MW and 50MW standalone BESS from PSPCL (L1 - not counted).

companies.name: PNC Infratech Ltd
companies.why: 15-Aug-2025 LoA from NHPC for solar project with energy storage at Rs3.13/kWh (PPA 25 yrs); 13-Aug-2025 release describes it as 300MW solar with 150MW/600MWh ESS. Developer role; value not stated.

companies.name: Jupiter Wagons Ltd
companies.why: 10-Aug-2026 press release: subsidiary JEM Energy secured 100MW/400MWh BESS (WBSEDCL, 15-yr BOO; ~Rs400 cr supply/commissioning); says BESS order book now >500MWh. Earlier releases: containerised BESS launch (25-Sep-2025).

companies.name: NLC India Ltd
companies.why: 22-Jun-2025: subsidiary NLC India Renewables LoA from TNGECL for 250MW/500MWh BESS (summary text of NSE filing); 07-Aug-2025 release repeats it.

companies.name: NTPC Green Energy Ltd
companies.why: 07-Aug-2026 release: won 200MW/800MWh in WBSEDCL 500MW/2000MWh standalone BESS tender; earlier SECI/NHPC solar+ESS wins (10-Dec-2024, 24-Jan-2025).

companies.name: Tata Power Company Ltd
companies.why: 11-Nov-2025 release: TPREL secured TPC-D 100MW/200MWh BESS EPC (~Rs299 cr); 30-Jul-2026 FDRE project with 25MW/50MWh BESS for NTPC. BESS is small vs group size.

companies.name: Godawari Power and Ispat Ltd
companies.why: BESS manufacturing (funded steps): 12-Dec-2025 raised phase-1 BESS project from 10 GWh to 20 GWh (subsidiary GNEPL); 13-Apr-2026 supply agreement for LFP cells; 23-Apr-2026 supply agreement for BoS of 5MWh DC blocks. No BESS sales order seen.

companies.name: Waaree Energies Ltd
companies.why: Capacity: Board approved storage cell & BESS expansion 3.5 GWh to 20 GWh (~Rs8,000 cr capex, 16-Oct-2025); 29-Jul-2026 release: commenced 5.15 GWh automated BESS container manufacturing at Rola, Gujarat. 22-Jan-2026 presentation: a 10MWh BESS order (no separate filing found).

companies.name: Premier Energies Ltd
companies.why: Capacity: 09-Jul-2026 groundbreaking of 6 GWh BESS facility; 10-Sep-2026 JV with RCT for 12 GWh BESS manufacturing; presentations list 12 GWh BESS container plant. No BESS sales order seen.

companies.name: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Ltd
companies.why: Capacity: 25-May-2026 release - BESS plant under construction targeted operational by Q4, 2 GWh cell manufacturing on track; 10-Aug-2026 presentation - 10GWh BESS giga factory construction commenced. No BESS sales order seen.
